headings.usage: Used for all H1, H2, H3 elements to maintain a modern, geometric tech-forward look.

body.usage: Used for general paragraphs, descriptions, and UI text for high legibility.

monospace.usage: Used for data points, currency, numbers, and technical labels (tabular nums).

primary.description: A calm, earthy Moss/Olive Green replacing the aggressive orange. Brings trust, calm, and an architectural/organic feel.

rules: Avoid pure black or pure white without tint.
Use primary color sparingly for CTAs, highlights, and active states.
Never use full-screen bright gradients. Stick to muted, transparent glows.

visual_enhancers: Glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/70 or bg-black/60 for overlays, headers, and hero floating blocks.
Grain Texture: Added a subtle noise/grain texture (.grain class) to hero backgrounds to break the digital flatness.
Glow Rings: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows behind primary interactive blocks (e.g., the hero AI prompt block).

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section separation. Cramped designs look cheap.
layouts.hero: Asymmetric Split: 5-col / 7-col layout. Left side text & prompt, Right side Interactive 3D.
layouts.features: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode): Asymmetrical grid-cols-12. Varing col-spans (e.g., col-span-4 vs col-span-8) to create visual tension.
layouts.container: Max-width 1500px to allow large imagery and bento grids to stretch comfortably.

Interactive3D.usage: Embedded in the hero section to immediately deliver the '3D vision' requirement. Passed mock rooms/walls for default state.

BentoCards.usage: Feature cards use relative positioning with hidden hover gradients that reveal on mouse over.

LanguageToggle.usage: Maintains FR/EN/ES support seamlessly via context.

motion.framer_motion: Used for entry staggering. Container sets staggerChildren, items spring up.
motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and reveal a soft gradient. Icons scale by 1.1x.
motion.accordion: FAQ section uses pure CSS max-height transition for performance, or framer-motion AnimatePresence if expanded.

accessibility: All text meets APCA/WCAG contrast ratios against the new background colors.
data-testid added to every button, link, and interactive card for stable testing.
Focus rings: visible outline on all inputs and buttons when focused (focus-within:ring-2).
3d_libraries: three.js (existing in package.json, used inside Interactive3D.jsx)
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center-align the main App container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Use generous padding (2x normal, e.g., p-8 or p-12 on cards).
Do not use fully transparent backgrounds under dropdowns or modals; always use solid colors or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur).
Always apply focus states and explicit hover colors (e.g., hover:text-white).
Respect the BTP (Construction) persona: modern, professional, avoiding overly playful 'startup' aesthetics (no purple/pink gradients, no emoji icons).
